artifacts.provenance: Each manifest records the consumer HEAD, relative source SHA-256 values, rustc version, compiler binary hash and artifact hashes. The runner checks current source hashes; the loader checks bundle hashes and ABI. Local dirty sources are attributable by hashes rather than HEAD alone.
